rationale: Build on the current reverse recurrent-tail best instead of another scalar sweep. This adds one new control tensor per recurrent tail block to blend between the proven decoder-output anchor and a pre-tail input anchor, so the recurrent pass can learn whether each tail block should pull from the fully decoded state or from the cleaner pre-tail state. It is compile-stable, tiny in byte cost, export-friendly because the new gates stay in the float-kept control path, and directly targets the recurrent-tail/quantization interaction that remains the strongest local motif.
title: Dual-Anchor Mix For Reverse Tail Recurrence
